summary:
Scope: src/domain/** (32 files, ~7.0k LOC) and src/services/** (7 files, ~2.5k LOC), with consumer grep. Verifier result: 22 findings = 12 confirmed, 10 adjusted, 0 refuted. 9 proposed splits = 7 confirmed, 2 adjusted.

CORE DIAGNOSIS (holds): the domain is a flat namespace of 24 modules (src/domain/mod.rs:3-27), not a set of bounded contexts. Its problems:
- presentation inside the domain: 12 files, 141 fl! calls (verified count);
- primitive OBS identity: SceneId/InputId are String aliases (45 and 49 references);
- the rename-safe identity rule copied by hand in several places;
- no anti-corruption layer (ACL) at storage (storage/registry.rs:48-62 persists domain types directly);
- OBS wire facts in the domain;
- several long methods.

CRITICAL ADJUSTMENT FOR IMPLEMENTERS (finding 01 and the mod.rs split): do NOT move every label into src/ui/presenters.
- The controller calls domain labels: OutputKind::label and OutputRunState::label at controller/state.rs:670, and PresetOutcome::description at controller/state/audio_presets.rs:49.
- The test background_layers_hold_no_gtk_or_ui (src/architecture_tests.rs:669-672) forbids `crate::ui` in controller/, storage/ and obs/.
- Fix: create a GTK-free src/presentation/ module (depends only on domain + infra::i18n), usable by both controller/ and ui/, or have the controller log typed events and localize at render.
- The proposed `-symbolic` ban for src/domain must wait until ICON_CATALOGUE icon_name values (src/domain/icon.rs, 33 occurrences) move too.

OTHER CORRECTIONS:
- Finding 13 is a smell, not a correctness bug. Reports store the resolved name string at record time (controller/state/session_reports.rs:346-351), and alerts are recomputed every tick from the same watches vector.
- Finding 17's production caller is AppState at controller/state.rs:1177, not refresh_controller.
- Finding 18: the architecture_tests.rs:463-476 strings are scanner fixtures, so they will not break when domain::obs moves.
- Finding 05: SceneRegistrySnapshot lives in domain/registry.rs:112-155, not in storage. The scanner skips #[cfg(test)] code, which is why audio_preset.rs:102 passes today.
- Finding 03: AudioPreset::valid and the AudioMonitor duplicate-rule count are a different rule ("targets in a set are distinct"), not resolution against inventory.

Recommended order:
1. Golden-file serde tests for registry.json, show-workspaces.json and report JSON.
2. kernel/identity with ObsRef + resolve().
3. The presentation module (non-ui).
4. Context directories behind `pub use` shims.
5. The storage DTOs.
6. The ControlAction nesting.

findings.title: Presentation (Fluent labels, CSS classes, GTK icon names) is baked into 12 domain modules
findings.evidence: LANGUAGE_LOADER appears in 12 domain files with 141 fl! calls: icon 32, hotkey 23, control 16, role 13, meter 12, audio_preset/run 10, mixer 9, output 9, graph 6, diagnostic 6, audio 4, appearance 1. GTK view knowledge also sits on domain enums: AudioSourceScope::css_class (audio.rs:63-70), DiagnosticSeverity::icon_name/css_class (diagnostic.rs:32-47), EdgeStatus::icon_name/css_class. PresetOutcome::description hard-codes the glyphs ✓/— (run.rs:96-113). Domain tests assert English text: role.rs:113 "Unassigned" and diagnostic.rs:152-157 "1 error".
findings.recommendation:
ORIGINAL:
1. Create src/ui/presenters/{program,audio,outputs,diagnostics,workspace,hotkey,appearance}.rs.
2. Use free functions or a Present trait.
3. Move one enum per commit.
4. Move the English-text assertions into presenter tests.
5. Add domain_has_no_presentation to architecture_tests.rs, forbidding LANGUAGE_LOADER, fl!(, css_class and -symbolic under src/domain.

ADJUSTED (see verifier_note):
- Put localized labels in a new GTK-free module src/presentation/ (or src/infra/labels/). It may import domain + infra::i18n only.
- Only css_class and icon_name go to src/ui/presenters/.
- Add an architecture test: domain, services, obs and storage must not import crate::presentation.
- The `-symbolic` ban lands last, after IconChoice.icon_name moves out of src/domain/icon.rs.
findings.risk: Domain tests depend on the locale through the global loader. Every copy change edits domain files.
findings.verifier_note:
The evidence is verified (12 files, 141 fl! calls, the cited test assertions and css/icon methods). The recommendation as written would break src/architecture_tests.rs:669-672 (background_layers_hold_no_gtk_or_ui forbids `crate::ui` in controller/), because the controller calls domain labels:
- `kind.label()` and `status.state.label()` at controller/state.rs:670, written into the activity log;
- `outcome.description()` at controller/state/audio_presets.rs:49.

A purely ui/ presenter location therefore fails. Either use a non-ui presentation module, or change the controller to store typed activity entries and localize at render time; the second option changes persisted report text, so it needs a golden test.

The ban on `-symbolic` would trip the 33 icon names in src/domain/icon.rs ICON_CATALOGUE (IconChoice.icon_name). Move icon_name into ui first and keep only the stable `key` in the domain.

findings.title: OBS identity is primitive and modelled four different ways
findings.recommendation:
Create src/domain/kernel/identity.rs with:
- newtypes SceneName, InputName and ObsUuid (non-empty);
- `ObsRef<N> { name, uuid: Option<ObsUuid> }` with the ActionTarget::matches semantics;
- a HasObsIdentity trait.

Migrate in this order:
1. Newtypes with Deref<Target=str> + serde(transparent).
2. `type ActionTarget = ObsRef<String>`.
3. Replace SceneId module by module.
4. Collapse AudioInput.id/name.

Guard with the tests at operator_input.rs:86-126, preflight.rs:344-369 and health/audio.rs:389-416.
findings.smell: Primitive Obsession / Alternative Classes with Different Interfaces
findings.risk: A scene name can be passed where an input name is expected. An empty UUID is representable.

findings.title: The "unambiguous identity resolution" business rule is re-implemented in several places
findings.recommendation:
Add to kernel/identity.rs:
- `enum Resolution<'a,T> { Unique(&'a T), Missing, Ambiguous }`;
- `fn resolve(items, target) -> Resolution`.

Replace the resolution copies. Add a table test first covering rename-by-uuid, name reuse with a new uuid, duplicate uuid, duplicate name and name-only targets.

Separately, add `fn targets_distinct(targets: &[ObsRef]) -> bool` for the set-distinctness rule used by AudioPreset::valid (audio_preset.rs:62-76) and the duplicate-rule check in AudioMonitor::observe (health/audio.rs:78-86).
findings.risk: Copies drift, so a live action, preflight and health can disagree about the target.
findings.verifier_note:
Verified that action_catalog.rs:215-226 is a verbatim copy of resolve_input over ActionTarget.

Adjusted the dupe list. audio_preset.rs:62-76 and health/audio.rs:78-86 do not resolve a target against inventory. They check that the targets inside one configured set do not collide (name OR identity), which is a different rule, so they need their own helper and must not be folded into resolve().

Scene checks: the preflight scene check skips the name-uniqueness clause, but OBS scene names are unique within a collection, so that difference is harmless for scenes. resolve() must still return Ambiguous rather than None so preflight can keep its Unknown result (preflight.rs:139). Note also that action_catalog's scene path returns None on ambiguity while preflight maps it to Unknown; the Resolution enum keeps both.

findings.title: Domain policy "resolve an OperatorAction against current observations" lives in the UI and uses OBS request names as strings
findings.recommendation:
1. Add an ObsCapability enum + CapabilitySet in src/domain/workspace/capability.rs, mapped from the request-name strings in src/obs/mapper.rs.
2. Add src/domain/workspace/resolution.rs with a ResolutionContext and `OperatorAction::resolve(&ctx) -> Option<Resolved>`.
3. Build the context with an AppState method; action_catalog.rs only renders.
4. Port the tests at ui/action_catalog.rs:795-1137 to the domain.
findings.smell: Feature Envy / Message Chains / anemic domain model
findings.risk: The safety-critical operator rule can only be tested through UI state.

findings.lines: 14-35,37-49,80-97,99-131 (also storage/registry.rs:46-62; health.rs:5-15; action_shortcut.rs:8-22; operator_action.rs:24-62; preflight.rs:6-39; appearance.rs:284-290; mixer.rs:104-121)
findings.title: No anti-corruption layer at storage: domain structs are the on-disk serde schema
findings.recommendation:
1. Write golden-file round-trip tests first.
2. Add DTOs under src/storage/registry/dto/{action_binding,operator_pin,audio_rule,audio_preset}.rs, src/storage/show_workspaces/dto.rs and src/storage/report_export/dto.rs, with TryFrom<Dto> for Domain and From<&Domain> for Dto.
3. Move deserialize_presets into the storage DTO.
4. Closed-set string enums may keep serde in the domain; document that exception.
5. Extend domain_and_services_do_not_reach_into_storage to cover #[cfg(test)] blocks, ONLY after moving the audio_preset.rs:99-131 round-trip test into storage/registry.rs.
findings.risk: Renaming a domain field silently changes or breaks users' registry.json and show-workspaces.json.
findings.verifier_note:
The core evidence is verified at storage/registry.rs:46-62 and audio_preset.rs:80-131.

Correction 1: the cited "SceneRegistrySnapshot (registry.rs:113-155)" is src/domain/registry.rs:112-155, not storage/registry.rs. storage/registry.rs:113-155 holds RuleConfig and the error enums. The point still stands: storage converts RuleConfig into the domain GraphDependencyPolicy, so two policies coexist.

Correction 2: today's architecture scanner exempts test-only code (src/architecture_tests.rs:84 test_only, test at 368-397), which is why audio_preset.rs:102 passes domain_and_services_do_not_reach_into_storage (625-632). Extending the rule to tests fails immediately unless that test moves first; the recommendation now orders this.

Also, ScopeBinding (workflow.rs:6-11) and PresetPlan.scope are serde types that need DTO coverage.

findings.title: Invariants are checked by after-the-fact valid() predicates on public-field structs, and two name rules diverge
findings.recommendation:
1. Create OperatorLabel<const MAX> in kernel/label.rs. Keep two explicit policies (Trimmed vs Exact) unless the author approves unifying them.
2. Make AudioPreset fields private with try_new.
3. Replace PresetPlan's elapsed() with `is_fresh(now)`.
4. Replace ActionShortcut's public fields with `ActionShortcut::try_new(key, modifiers)`. A standalone ShortcutKey type cannot carry the rule, because validity depends on the modifiers (action_shortcut.rs:43-50: non-F keys need ctrl/alt/logo).
5. Keep the existing tests passing.
findings.risk: Invalid values can exist in memory whenever a path skips valid().
findings.verifier_note:
All cited lines verified. Three adjustments:
1. The proposed ShortcutKey(String) cannot encode the rule alone: `self.key == "space"` or a lowercase char is valid only when modified (action_shortcut.rs:43-50), and F1-F24 are valid without modifiers. The invariant belongs to ActionShortcut as a whole.
2. The two name policies may be intentional. The bookmark path trims on store (controller/state/bookmarks.rs:59), while preset names round-trip exactly. Do not unify them without the author's sign-off.
3. Making fields private on serde types still works with derive, but every `preset.inputs` access across controller/ui needs accessors. Grep before starting.

findings.title: OBS protocol facts leak into the domain (missing ACL at obs/)
findings.recommendation:
1. Move the raw meter conversion to src/obs/mapper.rs. The only production caller is obs/mapper.rs:183.
2. Keep a `#[cfg(test)]` builder in the domain (InputLevels::from_db or a test_support helper). from_mul is used by tests in domain/health/audio.rs:244,465, services/meter_service.rs:404-421 and ui/preflight/tests.rs:79.
3. Replace is_text_kind with a domain SourceCapability computed in obs/mapper.rs.
4. Add an AudioTracks newtype.
5. Document gain tolerance on a LinearGain.
findings.risk: An OBS protocol change edits domain files.
findings.verifier_note:
Verified:
- is_text_kind at control.rs:287-297, with consumers only at obs/client.rs:652 and 967;
- from_mul at meter.rs:89-97 and 127-139, with the only production caller at obs/mapper.rs:183.

No architecture risk: obs/ already imports the domain. The test callers in services/ and ui/ cannot import crate::obs (ui_never_reaches_the_obs_adapter_directly, although test code is exempt), so a domain-side test builder is still the cleaner path.

findings.title: ControlAction is a 22-variant god enum spanning five bounded contexts; control.rs mixes them all
findings.evidence:
ControlAction (221-285) has 22 variants across five contexts: Program, Outputs, Media, Audio and Sources.
- `impl ControlAction` at line 14 comes before the enum is declared at 221.
- The same file holds ControlSnapshot, StudioState, SourceItem, SourceDetail, SourceFilter, MediaStatus, MediaState, WorkspaceWarning, AudioSettings and AudioMonitor.
- 18 files reference ControlAction.
findings.recommendation:
1. Split the data structs into program/studio.rs, outputs/command.rs, audio/settings.rs (rename AudioMonitor to AudioMonitoring) and workspace/source.rs, re-exporting them from control.rs.
2. Nest the commands: `ControlAction { Program(..), Output(..), Audio(..), Source(..) }`, one context at a time, with From impls.
3. Delete the shim last.
findings.smell: Large Class (god enum) / Divergent Change / Shotgun Surgery
findings.risk: Every OBS feature edits one shared enum and every match over it.

findings.title: Gain/decibel knowledge is duplicated, ranges are implicit, and AudioService is a Middle Man
findings.evidence:
- The mul→dB formula appears twice: audio::volume_mul_to_db (f64, audio.rs:10-17) and meter::db_from_mul (f32 input, meter.rs:104-110).
- Ranges: PresetGain 0..=20 (audio_preset.rs:24), sanitize_volume_mul clamps to 0..=max_volume_mul()=1 (audio_service.rs:71-77), MAX_VOLUME_DB 0.
- AudioService (audio_service.rs:19-78) is a unit struct of forwarders plus format_db, with 36 call sites outside services (ui/widgets/audio_card.rs 31, ui/pages/mixer.rs 5).
findings.recommendation:
1. Add src/domain/audio/gain.rs with LinearGain/Decibels and named FADER_RANGE/PRESET_RANGE constants.
2. Move VolumeChangeDebouncer to src/services/audio_debounce.rs.
3. Turn the forwarders into newtype methods and delete AudioService.
4. Move format_db to the presentation layer (format_db is not localized, so ui/presenters is fine).
5. Do NOT drop AudioInput.volume_db in this step; see verifier_note.
findings.smell: Duplicate Code / Middle Man / Primitive Obsession
findings.risk: The same f64 means linear gain in some places and dB in others.
findings.verifier_note:
The duplication and the Middle Man are verified, including the 36 call sites. Two corrections:
1. The "inconsistent ranges" are intentional and documented. PresetGain's doc says "Finite OBS linear gain, including digital silence and positive dB levels" (audio_preset.rs:13), because presets save observed OBS gain exactly, which can be above 0 dB. The fader is limited to 0 dB by design (audio.rs:8, "Maximum gain allowed by SceneDeck's audio controls"). Name the two ranges explicitly; do not "fix" them.
2. AudioInput carries both volume_mul and volume_db because OBS reports both (inputVolumeMul and inputVolumeDb). Deriving dB from mul could change displayed values slightly at the f32 boundary. Treat that collapse as a separate, test-first change, not part of this refactor.

findings.title: Freshness, meter-evidence and threshold rules are duplicated between Preflight and Health
findings.evidence:
- `fn fresh` (preflight.rs:85-88) is the same as fresh_within (health.rs:146-149).
- The trusted-meter filter is written twice: preflight.rs:177-186 checks peak_db only; health/audio.rs:108-118 checks peak_db and input_peak_db.
- The -50 dB threshold is a literal at preflight.rs:191 and health/audio.rs:135.
- The disk validity filter appears at preflight.rs:152-153 and health.rs:242.
findings.recommendation:
1. Add kernel/observation.rs with fresh_within + Observed<T>.
2. Add SIGNAL_FLOOR_DB and InputLevelSnapshot::trusted() in the audio meter module.
3. Add a DiskSpace newtype that rejects NaN and negatives.
4. Keep the preflight minimum (user-configurable u64, PreflightPlan::default at preflight.rs:26) and health's LOW_DISK_MIB (f64 constant, health.rs:28) as separate named concepts. If the author wants the default tied to the alert threshold, make it explicit, e.g. `DEFAULT_MINIMUM_DISK_MIB = LOW_DISK_MIB as u64`.
5. Decide the peak_db vs input_peak_db difference explicitly.
findings.risk: Preflight and Health can disagree on the same meter data.
findings.verifier_note:
The duplication is verified at every cited line. Adjusted the disk part: the two 1024 values are different concepts with different types. One is a user-editable u64 plan default with None meaning skip (preflight.rs:13-14, 26); the other is a fixed f64 health incident threshold (health.rs:28). Sharing one constant would couple a user preference to an alert rule, so keep the names separate and only tie them explicitly if desired.

Meter freshness windows also differ intentionally: preflight uses 2 s (preflight.rs:179), health uses METER_GAP. Parameterize; do not unify.

findings.title: PreflightReview::evaluate is a ~108-line method with nesting depth 7 and positional result arrays
findings.evidence:
- evaluate spans 106-214, and the microphone branch nests 159-209.
- `microphone: [CheckStatus; 3]` (62) is indexed at 165, 171, 195, 206 and 210.
- It mutates self.signal_at at 193 and 211.
- `use` statements sit mid-file at 41-47.
findings.recommendation:
1. Split into preflight/{plan,report,review,checks}.rs.
2. Add `MicrophoneChecks { present, unmuted, signal }`.
3. Extract check_collection, check_scenes, check_disk and check_microphone, plus an explicit record_signal.
4. Keep evaluate as orchestration.
findings.smell: Long Method / deep nesting / Primitive Obsession (positional array)
findings.risk: Readiness gating is the hardest domain code to change safely.
findings.verifier_note:
All lines verified. Callers that MicrophoneChecks must keep working:
- ui/preflight.rs:366-368 indexes report.microphone[0..2];
- ready() at preflight.rs:216-223 does `.chain(&report.microphone)`. MicrophoneChecks needs an `iter()` or an IntoIterator impl, or ready() must change in the same commit.

The From<MicrophoneChecks> for [CheckStatus;3] adapter in the split plan covers the UI side.

findings.title: HealthMonitor: long methods, a long parameter list, and an impl split across files that reaches into private state
findings.evidence:
- observe_stats takes 6 parameters (health.rs:180-188) and runs 180-262.
- AudioMonitor::observe runs 59-148.
- events.rs:105-111 mutates `self.previous.encoding/stream`, private sample state owned by the stats logic in health.rs.
- Per-output state is `outputs: [events::OutputWatch; 2]` indexed through index() (events.rs:35-40).
- AudioRule is declared before the `use` block (health.rs:5-21).
findings.recommendation:
1. Split into diagnostics/health/{mod,sustained,stats_alerts,output_alerts,audio_alerts}.rs.
2. Add a StatsObservation parameter object.
3. Add PerOutput<T>.
4. Add invalidate_baseline(kind).
5. Move AudioRule to workspace/audio_rule.rs.
findings.smell: Long Method / Long Parameter List / Inappropriate Intimacy
findings.risk: Changing hysteresis needs reasoning across three files.
findings.verifier_note:
All lines verified. The only production caller of observe_stats is controller/state.rs:1167-1168, so the parameter-object change touches one site.

Dependency note: PerOutput placed in outputs/ means diagnostics depends on outputs. That direction already exists (events.rs:3 imports domain::output), so it creates no cycle.

findings.title: AlertKind::AudioSilence(usize)/AudioClipping(usize) use a rule-vector index as identity (smell; no demonstrated mislabel)
findings.evidence:
- The audio alert kind carries the watch index (health/audio.rs:176-180).
- name(index) falls back to an empty String (149-154).
- Consumers resolve the index back to a name at session_reports.rs:346-351 and ui/health_alerts.rs:36-45.
findings.recommendation: Key audio alerts by a stable identity: an AudioRuleId(u32), or the ObsRef from finding 02. Replace name(index) with `target_name(id) -> Option<&str>`, so there is no empty-string fallback. Treat this as a cleanup, sequenced after finding 02.
findings.smell: Primitive Obsession (index as identity) / Null Check (empty-string fallback)
findings.risk: Low today. Fragile if alerts are ever cached across a rule edit.

findings.title: ReportEvent::Health is stringly typed, and the enum-to-string mapping lives in the controller
findings.evidence:
- The Health variant is `{ kind: String, input: Option<String>, phase: Option<String> }` (51-55).
- The AlertKind→"connection_lost" and AlertPhase→"active" mappings are hand-written in controller/state/session_reports.rs:338-361.
- The Ended variant is `{ reason: String }` (56-58).
findings.recommendation:
1. Add a serde `HealthAlertKind` (snake_case) and serde on AlertPhase, keeping the wire spelling identical. Write a golden test first.
2. Move the mapping into `impl From<&Alert>`.
3. For Ended.reason, see verifier_note: it is localized free text today. Either keep it as String, or introduce a SessionEndReason enum and localize at render; the latter changes report JSON content and needs a migration decision from the author.
findings.smell: Primitive Obsession / Feature Envy (controller maps domain enums)
findings.risk: Persisted reports can drift from the alert model without a compile error.
findings.verifier_note:
The Health part is verified (session_reports.rs:338-361).

The Ended.reason part needs care. finish_report(reason: &str) (session_reports.rs:212-221) receives LOCALIZED labels: `ObsStatus::Connecting.label()` at controller/state.rs:755 and `status.label()` at state.rs:861. Existing persisted reports therefore contain translated reason text. A SessionEndReason enum is not a pure refactor: old reports must still deserialize (for example with a fallback `Other(String)` variant).

findings.title: Doctor rules and edge classification are domain logic misplaced in services (Feature Envy on GraphDependencyPolicy)
findings.evidence:
- classify_edge (graph_service.rs:19-53) reads only GraphDependencyPolicy fields; the policy is defined at domain/registry.rs:39-48.
- DoctorService is a unit struct used as a namespace (doctor_service.rs:14-47).
- services/mod.rs:1-4 docs are vague.
findings.recommendation:
1. Turn classify_edge into `GraphDependencyPolicy::classify` in program/policy.rs.
2. Move the rules to domain/diagnostics/doctor.rs.
3. Move doctor_format to the presentation layer.
4. Rewrite the services/mod.rs docs.
findings.smell: Feature Envy / Lazy Class (namespace unit struct)
findings.risk: Low runtime risk. Ownership of rules is ambiguous.

findings.title: Doctor finding order depends on HashMap iteration and can change between launches
findings.evidence:
- `scenes: HashMap<SceneId, SceneMetadata>` (registry.rs:115).
- `pub edges: HashMap<SceneId, Vec<SceneId>>` (graph.rs:171).
- evaluate does a stable sort by severity only (doctor_service.rs:45).
- The test at 589+ derives the expected order from registry.scenes() iteration.
findings.recommendation: Use BTreeMap for SceneRegistrySnapshot.scenes and SceneGraph.edges, or add a secondary sort key. Update the test. This is a behaviour change, so confirm with the author.
findings.risk: Doctor rows reorder between launches.
findings.verifier_note: Verified. The consumer ui/pages/doctor.rs:141-142 renders DoctorService::run output directly without re-sorting, so the nondeterministic order reaches the UI. std HashMap RandomState is seeded per process. cycle_edges sorts its output (graph.rs:239), as the reviewer said.

findings.title: StatsHistory::push reads the wall clock inside the domain
findings.evidence: push() calls SystemTime::now() (173-177) and delegates to the private push_at (181), which tests use (446-448).
findings.recommendation: Make push_at(timestamp_unix_ms, ...) the only public entry. The production caller AppState::observe stats path at controller/state.rs:1177-1178 should pass crate::controller::workspace::unix_ms(), the helper already used by session_reports.rs:213. Delete push(), and update the test callers in domain/stats.rs:360-426 and ui/pages/stats.rs:1037-1066 (cfg(test) block starting at 913).
findings.risk: Small.
findings.verifier_note: The smell is verified. The reviewer named the wrong caller: refresh_controller does not call push. The only production call is the AppState method at controller/state.rs:1177 on the GTK thread, where `at: Instant` and `Instant::now()` are already in hand (state.rs:1167-1168). Tests in ui/pages/stats.rs call push() too and must migrate.

findings.title: Flat 24-module domain and inconsistent ubiquitous language (scope / workspace / registry / workflow)
findings.evidence:
- domain/mod.rs:3-27 is a flat list mixing pub and pub(crate).
- workflow.rs holds both ScopeBinding and ActivityLog.
- The endpoint string is built as `format!("{}:{}", host, port)` at controller/state.rs:788-796.
- The `(u64,u64)` health scope comes from (workspace.epoch, show_registry.generation) at state.rs:957-960.
findings.recommendation:
1. Adopt the context layout.
2. ScopeBinding → ProductionScope{Endpoint, CollectionName}, with serde(transparent) newtypes and the field names unchanged (ScopeBinding is Serialize/Deserialize + deny_unknown_fields, workflow.rs:6-11).
3. `(u64,u64)` → WorkspaceGeneration.
4. WorkspaceWarning → InventoryReadWarning.
5. Move workflow.rs to session/activity.rs.
6. Add a glossary to docs/architecture.md.
findings.risk: Overloaded words cause mistakes.
findings.verifier_note:
The evidence is verified. Two corrections:
1. The claim "architecture_tests.rs:463-476 hard-codes the path domain::obs::ObsNamedList; update it in the same commit" is wrong. Those strings are synthetic inputs to the scanner unit test scanner_expands_grouped_imports_before_checking_aliases (456-477). They test import parsing, not real module paths, so moving domain::obs does not break them. Updating them is optional cosmetic work.
2. ScopeBinding is persisted (serde + deny_unknown_fields), so the rename must keep the wire field names.

findings.title: MixerSelection mixes persisted preference with session-only UI state
findings.evidence:
- `#[serde(skip)] search` (112-113) and `#[serde(skip)] locked_inputs` (119-120) sit on a persisted struct.
- The manual Default impl (123-134) matches what derive would produce.
findings.recommendation: Split into MixerPreference (persisted) and MixerSession (AppState/ui). Derive Default.
findings.risk: Low.
findings.verifier_note: Verified. MixerMode has #[default] ActiveScene (mixer.rs:12-13) and MixerGrouping has #[default] Scope (63-64), so derive(Default) produces the same value as the manual impl.

findings.title: graph.rs: tests placed mid-file before the type, and cycle_edges is a 60-line inline Kosaraju
findings.evidence:
- The #[cfg(test)] block at 62 precedes `pub struct SceneGraph` at 169.
- cycle_edges spans 182-241.
- `pub edges: HashMap` (171).
findings.recommendation:
1. Move the tests to the end of the file.
2. Extract reverse_adjacency, finish_order and components.
3. Make edges private behind from_edges/insert_edge.

findings.title: Boolean-flag constructor Modifiers::new(bool,bool,bool,bool), and app-reserved shortcuts duplicated between domain and ui
findings.evidence:
- Modifiers::new takes four positional bools (hotkey.rs:75-82).
- action_shortcut.rs:63-67 hard-codes F1 and Ctrl+q/r/k/,.
- ui/actions.rs registers the same accelerators: `<Primary>q` (22), `<Primary>r` (32), `<Primary>comma` (37), `F1` (44), `<Primary>k` (49).
findings.recommendation:
1. Add Modifiers::CTRL, ALT, SHIFT and SUPER consts plus a `with` combinator.
2. Add `RESERVED_APP_SHORTCUTS` in the domain.
3. ui/actions.rs derives its accel strings from that table, or a unit test asserts the two lists agree.
findings.risk: Low. The lists can drift.
findings.verifier_note: The reviewer's speculative part is now verified: the duplicate list exists at ui/actions.rs:22-49. Note that GTK accel strings use `comma` while the domain uses ",", so the shared table needs a key-to-accel mapping in ui.
